fee_notes: Base fee $49,500 for 200,000 population. Additional population $0.25/person. Multiple territory discounts apply. Veteran discount 15%; existing franchisee additional territory 20%; employee discount 5-50% based on tenure. Up to 80% financing available in limited cases. Non-refundable except $5,000 deduction if initial training not completed.
raw_excerpt: As set forth below, the initial franchise fee is $49,500 for a baseline population of 200,000. You may purchase additional population for a cost of $0.25 per person.
